## Hypothesis

The VWAP anchored entry (reclaim/rejection) parameter sweep identified a keeper configuration that captures modest edge on 5/01 winner day without adding losses on loser days. The edge likely stems from tighter volatility and proximity filters reducing false entries during choppy periods, though the low winner capture on 4/29 and 5/04 suggests the regime may be overfit to 5/01 conditions.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on VWAP reclaim/rejection when: volume > vol_mult * 20-bar avg volume, price within proximity_dollars of VWAP, lookback_bars confirms VWAP-side close, and body_min_cents filters weak candles. Exit uses TP1 at tp1_premium_pct (+50%) of entry premium for tp1_qty_fraction (0.667) of position, runner_target_pct (2.0) for remaining contracts, profit_lock activates at profit_lock_threshold_pct (+10%) with trail offset profit_lock_stop_offset_pct (+5%). Requires EMA ribbon agreement (require_ribbon_agreement=true) with minimum spread ribbon_min_spread_cents (30.0). Uses ITM-2 strikes (strike_offset=2) and qty=3.
